name: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN)
issuer: the Tax Department of the Ministry of Finance
note: Laos's Prime Minister's Decree No. 354/PM of 5 October 2007 on the Taxpayer Identification Number, read 2026-10-30 in the unofficial English translation the Lao Trade Portal (the government's trade portal) publishes, with the Ministry of Finance's Notification No. 0831/MOF of 10 February 2021 on registering individuals' TINs from the same portal. Art. 4: the TIN has four parts, an eight-digit ordering number, a single monitoring digit, then 9 for a taxpayer registered for VAT or 0 for one who isn't, then a two-digit branch number (00 for an enterprise without branches), written 'a a a a a a a a b – 9 c c': twelve digits, written here with no separator, the pattern taking 9 or 0 in the tenth place. The monitoring digit's algorithm isn't given, so no check is modelled. Art. 3: it applies to individuals, legal entities and organizations, foreigners working permanently or temporarily in Laos among them; art. 6 and 7: tax authorities register taxpayers and the Tax Department alone issues the TIN. So `when` is registration and `who` anyone. The 2021 notification asks individuals, domestic and foreign, who have income in Laos to register for a TIN at a tax office by 30 June 2021; it names no fee. Neither text sets an age, fee or time, or says in so many words what needs one, so those are left out. The decree is of 2007; the Law on Tax Administration No. 66/NA of 2019 wasn't read, and no later text changing the number's parts was found.

sources.title: Lao Trade Portal: Decree No. 354/PM of 5 October 2007 on Taxpayer Identification Number (unofficial translation)
sources.said: This Decree applies to individuals, legal entities, and organizations including foreigners operating businesses or working permanently or temporarily in the Lao PDR ... The TIN consists of 4 parts: ... The first part is an eight-digit ordering number to stipulate a number of taxpayer in sequence; ... The second part is a single-digit number for monitoring to enable a computer system to monitor such taxpayer number ... The third part is for a taxpayer registered in the Value-added Tax (VAT) system with number 9 after the monitoring number and number 0 for a taxpayer not registered in the VAT system; ... The fourth part is a two-digit identification number for a branch of an enterprise located in each locality. For an enterprise without branches, the number 00 will be applied. ... The Tax Department is the only authority assigned to issue a TIN.

sources.title: Lao Trade Portal: Ministry of Finance Notification No. 0831/MOF of 10 February 2021, Registration of Taxpayer Identification Number for Individuals (unofficial translation)
sources.said: To: Individuals, both domestics and foreign, who have income in Lao PDR ... Subject: Registration of Taxpayer Identification Number for Individuals
